name: Master/Slave Parallel Rendering Architecture
definition: A master/slave parallel rendering program for shared-memory architecture designed to generate movies from large-scale (TB-scale), three-dimensional, time-development simulation data within 12 hours.
summary: Master/Slave Parallel Rendering Architecture is a shared-memory strategy that generates visualization movies from large-scale data by using task overlapping to hide I/O latency with standard disk access.
